# Atticus

> AI Practice Intelligence for Ontario Law Firms — https://getatticus.ca

Atticus is a SaaS legal practice management platform built specifically for Ontario solo and small law firms. It combines AI-powered document intelligence, automated deadline tracking, billing, trust accounting, and conflict of interest checking in one product.

## Core Product

### AI Document Processing
Every uploaded document (PDF, DOCX, TXT) and audio file (MP3, MP4, M4A) is automatically processed:
- Text extracted from documents; audio transcribed by OpenAI Whisper
- Claude AI generates summaries and extracts entities: names, dates, dollar amounts, case references, parties, deadlines, and action items
- Documents chunked and embedded (Voyage AI) into pgvector for semantic search
- Lawyer receives an email immediately after processing with what was found

### AI Assistant (Atticus Chat)
- Named "Atticus" — an AI executive assistant scoped to the firm's practice
- Supports full-practice and client-scoped/matter-scoped chat modes
- Powered by Claude Sonnet 4.6 with RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) using pgvector semantic search
- Live practice context injected: overdue deadlines, due today, unbilled hours, outstanding invoices, trust balances per client
- Can answer questions like "Who owes me money?", "What's Smith's trust balance?", "Any overdue invoices?"
- Action tools (7 total — all executable from chat):
  - **add_deadline**: Create a deadline or action item
  - **log_time**: Log billable time
  - **resolve_deadline**: Mark a task as complete
  - **add_client_note**: Save a note on a client's record
  - **add_matter_note**: Save a note on a matter
  - **create_invoice**: Generate a draft invoice from unbilled time
  - **record_trust**: Record trust receipts and disbursements
- Conversation history persisted per session

### Daily Morning Briefing
- Automated email sent 9am ET Monday-Friday via Inngest cron + Resend
- Contains: all overdue deadlines and action items, due today, due within 7 days
- Also includes: overdue invoices, negative trust balances, unbilled time summary
- Compiled from extracted document entities + manually created items

### Deadline & Action Item Management
- Extracted automatically from every document
- Manual creation via Quick Capture floating button (any page)
- Recurring deadlines: weekly, monthly, yearly — auto-creates next occurrence when resolved
- Due Today card and Due This Week card on dashboard
- Bulk resolve multiple items at once
- Calendar view toggle for deadline visualization
- Export deadlines to calendar (.ics) — importable into Outlook, Apple Calendar, Google Calendar
- Export deadlines to CSV for Excel/Sheets reporting
- Resolve items from UI, deadlines page, or via Atticus chat
- 6pm escalation alert email if deadlines due today/tomorrow are unresolved

### Ontario Limitation Period Calculator
- Built-in tool for Ontario solicitors and litigators
- Enter incident/trigger date and case type; calculator outputs all relevant limitation periods
- Supports: general (2-year), ultimate (15-year), minors (tolled to age 18), municipal notice (10 days), construction lien, sexual assault (no limitation), defamation
- Each period shows days remaining, urgency warnings, and applicable legislation citation
- One-click button adds any calculated period directly to the lawyer's deadline tracker
- Covers Limitations Act, 2002; Municipal Act, 2001 s. 44(10); Construction Act
- Helps prevent malpractice exposure from missed Ontario limitation periods

## Practice Management Features

### Clients
- Full client records: name, email, phone, company, notes
- AI-generated client brief from all processed documents
- Open deadline count and active matter count per client card
- Conflict of interest check on creation
- Shareable public intake form for new lead capture

### Matters
- Organized per client with status (active, pending, closed)
- 8 Ontario law matter templates with pre-populated action item checklists:
  - Residential Real Estate Purchase
  - Residential Real Estate Sale
  - Will and Powers of Attorney
  - Corporate Incorporation
  - Employment Agreement Review
  - Civil Litigation
  - Separation Agreement
  - Estate Administration
- Kanban board and list view toggle
- Progress bar showing percentage of tasks resolved
- Activity timeline: documents, time entries, trust transactions, entities
- Private notes per matter
- Matter-scoped Atticus AI chat
- AI-generated matter brief and status reports
- Live timer with auto-prefill on time log
- Document request workflow: AI drafts and sends email to client requesting specific documents
- Shareable client portal per matter (token-based public link, read-only)
- Client portal document upload: clients can upload PDFs, DOCX, audio files through their portal link — auto-processed by Atticus and linked to the matter
- "Notify Client" button: one-click sends portal link to client's email with optional custom message from the lawyer

### Billing
- AI Draft tool: generate demand letters, settlement proposals, client updates, follow-up emails, legal memos, closing statements, engagement letters, Statements of Claim/Defence (Ontario Rules of Civil Procedure), Affidavits, Notices of Motion, Wills (SLRA-compliant), Powers of Attorney (Substitute Decisions Act, 1992) — grounded in your RAG case files
- Invoice generation from billable document time and manual time entries
- Editable line items on draft invoices
- HST (13%) support for Ontario billing
- Send invoice to client via email
- Mark paid
- Automated overdue invoice reminder emails
- Trust account: receipts, disbursements, per-client balances
- Negative trust balance alerts in morning briefing
- Trust ledger CSV export (RFC 4180-compliant: Date, Type, Client, Matter, Description, Reference, Amount)
- Unbilled time highlighted separately on billing page
- CSV time log export
- Monthly billing summary and revenue goal progress bar on dashboard

### Conflict of Interest Checking
- AI-powered check using Claude against all existing clients, companies, and parties extracted from matter documents
- Returns severity rating (high/medium/low) with plain-language reasons
- Available from Search page, Conflicts page, Command Palette, and client creation

### Search and Navigation
- Semantic search across all documents and entities (pgvector)
- Command palette (Cmd+K) for clients, matters, navigation
- Global keyboard shortcuts (g+d for dashboard, g+c for clients, g+m for matters, etc.)
- Notification bell with grouped deadline alerts (overdue, today, this week)

### Analytics
- Revenue: total invoiced, collected, outstanding, overdue
- Monthly revenue chart (12 months)
- Hours by client (pie chart)
- Matter status breakdown
- Documents processed per week
- Logged hours per week
- Deadline completion rate (last 30 days)

### Settings and Compliance
- Firm name, lawyer name, hourly rate
- Monthly revenue goal tracking
- Email preferences (daily briefing on/off)
- AI Consent Gate on first login disclosing AI use and data residency (LSO Rule 3.3)
- Consent timestamped and stored

## Technical Architecture

- Frontend: Next.js 14 App Router, TypeScript strict mode, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui
- API: tRPC v10 (type-safe, end-to-end)
- Database: PostgreSQL with pgvector extension (Railway-hosted)
- ORM: Drizzle ORM
- Auth: Clerk
- Background jobs: Inngest (serverless event-driven functions)
- AI: Claude (Anthropic) for summarization, entity extraction, chat, action tools
- Transcription: OpenAI Whisper
- Embeddings: Voyage AI (voyage-law-2 model)
- Email: Resend
- File storage: Cloudflare R2
- Payments: Stripe (subscriptions with 14-day free trial)
- Deployment: Railway (Canadian infrastructure)

## Pricing

- Free Trial: 14 days, full access, no credit card required
- Atticus Pro: $149 CAD per lawyer per month
  - Unlimited document processing
  - All AI features including Atticus chat with action tools
  - Invoicing, billing analytics, HST support
  - Trust account tracking
  - Conflict of interest checks
  - Client portal and intake forms
  - Priority support

## Compliance and Privacy

- All data stored in Canada
- Data is never used to train AI models
- PIPEDA-compliant
- LSO Rule 3.3 AI disclosure consent flow built in
- Sub-processor data processing agreements with Anthropic, OpenAI, Voyage AI, Clerk, Resend
- Encryption in transit and at rest

## Target Market

Ontario solo and small law firms (1-5 lawyers). Primary pain points addressed:
- Missing deadlines and limitation periods
- Hours lost to administrative tasks (transcription, filing, searching)
- Poor document searchability across a growing file library
- Conflict of interest exposure from manual checking
